nodes.label: golangci-lint v2 config
nodes.rationale: Opt-in linter set (govet, staticcheck, errcheck, ineffassign, unused) with gofmt/goimports as formatters; run timeout 5m.

nodes.label: setup-go-web composite action
nodes.rationale: Shared CI preamble for Go jobs; runs after checkout. Sets up Go (go-version-file: go.mod), pnpm and Node (LTS, pnpm cache keyed on pnpm-lock.yaml), then runs `make web` so every Go job builds against the current embedded frontend.

nodes.label: setup-web composite action
nodes.rationale: Shared CI preamble for frontend jobs; runs after checkout. Sets up pnpm and Node (LTS, pnpm cache keyed on pnpm-lock.yaml) and performs a frozen install.

nodes.label: ci workflow (main push)
nodes.rationale: All quality gates, shared verbatim with the PR workflow, plus the five cross-compile OS builds and a frontend production build.

nodes.label: ci-pr workflow
nodes.rationale: Minimal pre-merge feedback: runs the same quality gates that run on main (via the shared workflow), without the OS builds.

nodes.label: quality workflow (shared gates)
nodes.rationale: Reusable workflow_call shared verbatim by ci-pr and ci: five independent jobs covering backend tests + coverage, backend lint, frontend tests, frontend lint, and frontend typecheck.

nodes.label: Frontend embed build (make web)
nodes.rationale: The action's last step runs `make web`, which builds web/dist and syncs it into internal/webui/dist so Go jobs compile the //go:embed dist fresh on every CI run.

nodes.label: Frozen-lockfile install
nodes.rationale: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` makes CI install exactly what the committed pnpm-lock.yaml pins, so frontend builds are reproducible regardless of when the job runs.

nodes.label: Pull request template
nodes.rationale: Documents repo conventions for PRs: conventional-commit title (feat/fix/ci/docs/refactor/test/chore), ci-pr runs the quality gates and final-gate posts its report as a comment and must pass before merging, and no secrets or generated files (web/dist/, internal/webui/dist/, *.db) may be committed. Includes a how-verified checklist mirroring the local make check gates.

nodes.label: Single required CI check pattern
nodes.rationale: Branch protection wants one required check. final-gate is a reusable workflow_call that runs with `if: always()` regardless of the other jobs' outcomes, so its step summary always renders the per-job report — then it fails unless every other job succeeded. Both ci and ci-pr delegate to it with wrapper: final-gate so the wrapper's own job is excluded from the report.

nodes.label: 80% coverage floor
nodes.rationale: Total coverage across internal/ and cmd/ must stay >= 80%; enforced in CI by merging the coverprofile and awk-ing the total line to fail the job when below the floor. Mirrors the local `make cover` gate.

nodes.label: golangci-lint cache rationale
nodes.rationale: golangci-lint keeps its analysis cache in ~/.cache/golangci-lint and runner.tool_cache does not persist on hosted runners, so the cache plus the downloaded v2.12.2 binary are cached explicitly with actions/cache; the version is part of the cache key so upgrades miss.

nodes.label: report job (summary + gate)
nodes.rationale: Queries the GitHub API for the run's jobs (excluding this job and the wrapper job), renders a per-job status table into the step summary, and on PR-triggered runs mirrors a prettier report onto the PR as a marker-tagged comment (<!-- thoth-ci-report -->), creating or updating it instead of stacking a new comment per run. Fails (test $failed -eq 0) unless every other job succeeded.
